IncidentBot: [ALERT] 03:12 UTC — spike in 5xx responses for /v1/generate (model: redwood-13B) affecting enterprise account 'Galileo Systems' (acct: GLA-998). 5xx rate ~14% over baseline. Paging oncall.
Oncall Pager: @oncall responding. confirming p95 latency up too. assigning to eng-runtime.
Oncall Pager: Current page: p95 720ms -> 1.6s, error burst started 03:10 UTC.
Alice K: I'm on it, pulling logs. tagging @Ben R for runtime kernel/queue check.
Ben R: Saw the alert. Initial read: continuous-batch queue growth on eu-west nodes serving Galileo routing policy. suspected autoscaler thrash + cold start cascading.
Lina (CSM): Heads-up — Galileo is on Dedicated Reserved pool with warm-capacity. This will be customer-visible. I need a tailored impact blurb for their SRE and executive nudges. Who can draft quick?
Alice K: Ben, any immediate mitigation we can do (traffic reroute / fallbacks)?
Ben R: Quick mitigations: 1) Pause autoscaler for GLA-998 2) Force route Galileo traffic to warm pool in us-east (compatible variant) 3) Drain overloaded eu-west hosts. Doing 1 & 2 now.
Oncall Pager: Executed pause-autoscaler GLA-998 -> confirmed. Routing override to warm-pool-us-east started at 03:18 UTC.
Ben R: Rolling revert plan ready if warm pool saturates: fallback -> model-redwood-7B-quant (lower perf but stable).
Lina (CSM): Drafting customer message. Need short status page snippet + email line for Galileo SRE and exec. Would prefer to include contact routing and expected ETA.
Alice K: ETA: 20-30m for full mitigation, updates every 15m. If fallback to 7B required, that will be announced.
Taylor O: I'll take status page update once Lina gives copy. Also confirm support routing: primary Galileo contacts = Maya R <maya@galileo.com> (SRE), Jordan P <jordan@galileo.com> (Platform), escalation PD link: https://pagerduty.com/galileo/team.
Lina (CSM): Copy for internal ops/customer — please review: 

-- INTERNAL FOR OPS (short) --
Affected: Galileo Systems (GLA-998) on Dedicated eu-west pool.
Impact: Increased 5xx on /v1/generate and elevated latency for requests routed to eu-west serving pool. Some requests are failing with 5xx, estimated 10–20% of traffic during spike window.
Mitigation in progress: paused autoscaler for GLA-998; traffic being routed to warm pool in us-east; draining problematic eu-west hosts. Fallback to model-redwood-7B-quant prepared if warm pool saturates.
ETA next update: 03:30 UTC; estimated mitigation complete by ~03:40–03:50 UTC.
Owner: Oncall (eng-runtime) / Ben R. CSM point: Lina.
Contact routing: CSM Lina -> Maya R (SRE). PD link above.

-- CUSTOMER-FACING BLURB (for Galileo SRE / exec) --
Galileo team — we're investigating an increase in error rates for requests routed to your eu-west dedicated pool that began at ~03:10 UTC. Our engineering team has paused autoscaling for your pool and is routing new traffic to a warm pool in us-east to reduce failures. We are actively draining and remediating the affected eu-west hosts. Estimated restoration within 30–40 minutes; we'll update you at 03:30 UTC and again as progress is made. If service quality degrades further we may temporarily route traffic to a lower-capacity model variant to preserve availability; we'll notify you before that change.

Please share any urgent account-specific impact (paying customers, live-facing apps) so we can prioritize.

-- STATUS PAGE SNIPPET --
```
Incident: Elevated 5xx errors for Galileo Systems (Dedicated eu-west)
Status: Degraded performance and increased errors
Started: 03:10 UTC
Customer impact: Some requests may fail or experience higher latency.
Mitigation: Traffic rerouted to warm pool in us-east; draining affected hosts.
Next update: 03:30 UTC
```

Alice K: LGTM for ops. Add a note that embeds/embeddings endpoints unaffected (if true). Confirmed: only /v1/generate impacted.
Ben R: Confirmed: embeddings unaffected.
Lina (CSM): I'll send the customer-facing message to Maya + Jordan now and cc their exec alias. Posting here for record before sending.
Lina (CSM): Sending now -> "Sent to Galileo SREs at 03:21 UTC."
Oncall Pager: Please record that we've opened incident ticket INC-GLA-2025-03-10-01 and added detailed timeline.
Status Writer: Status page updated with snippet at 03:23 UTC.
Alice K: Mitigation step: drained 3 eu-west hosts, observed request success rate climb to 93% for routed traffic. Still some error tail; continuing monitoring.
Ben R: Warm-pool capacity at 70% — holding. No fallback required yet.
Lina (CSM): Galileo reply: "Thanks — we're seeing reduced failures, will hold off scaling changes on our side. Keep us posted." Maya R.
Oncall Pager: Marking this thread for handoff at next on-call rotation. Current oncall to update handoff doc.
Taylor O: Handoff note: include timeline, routing override commands, pd link, customer contact list. I'll add to incident playbook.
Lina (CSM): Internal postmortem request: please flag if autoscaler setting drift contributed. I'll schedule customer follow-up with remediation timeline.
Ben R: Will follow up with kernel logs and autoscaler telemetry in postmortem.
Status Writer: Final update posted at 03:45 UTC: service restored for Galileo; monitoring for residual errors. Closing public incident page later after postmortem.
Oncall Pager: Acknowledged. Closing pager thread. :white_check_mark:
